tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Read the current Packagist facts for one PHP package: latest stable version, required PHP, license, and whether it is abandoned. Use it before composer require. Send vendor/package. Set version to ask about one release; version_found is false when that release is absent, and the latest stable is sti

tools.name: check_dependency
tools.description: Look up known vulnerabilities for one package version from OSV. Returns advisory id, summary, CVE aliases, severity string, and fixed versions when the advisory lists them. Ecosystems: packagist, npm, pypi, go, crates.io, maven, rubygems, nuget. Omit ecosystem and a vendor/package name uses Packagis
